timing: AFTER historical test scoring and inspection
baseline: GRU/D7, chosen using CV before its new old-test evaluation

primary_trio_report.test: two-sided paired Student t on per-seed pooled RMSE
primary_trio_report.effect: paired Cohen dz with4999 paired-seed bootstrap sensitivity

normality: Shapiro diagnostic only; does not select a different test

diagnostics.BDS: h1 monthly residuals, m2, epsilon1.5sampleSD, exploratory short-block iid diagnostic
diagnostics.LjungBox: h1 monthly residuals, lags1/5, model_df0; not ARMA df estimated for networks
diagnostics.DM: D7 three pairs, daily squared losses averaged over seeds; HAC Bartlett lag6, HLN h1, Holm3

margins: Prior frozen absolute delta retained as historical context; new5%GRU-CV margin declared now for future studies only

fixed_seed_illustration.format: PNG illustration of observed and predicted sigma7, not a machine-readable daily table

scope: Análisis del nuevo trío definido después de inspeccionar el test histórico; exploratorio y condicional al calendario y a la aleatoriedad de entrenamiento. No constituye confirmación temporal independiente.
